name: 陸瑞玲
objective:
本課程旨在培養學生具備健康相關知識、正向健康態度與自我健康管理能力，協助學生建立健康生活型態，以提升健康素養並促進終身健康。藉由「健康與生活」課程，學生將學習如何促進自身健康、減輕生活壓力並提升生活品質，探索影響健康的各項生活型態因素，並規劃個人健康促進方案，同時學習與家人及朋友共同營造支持性的健康環境，以達成健康目標。課程內容涵蓋四大主軸：(一) 健康與人生概述，包括人生的意義、健康的內涵及認識自己的身體；(二) 生理健康之道，包括健康飲食、體重控制、運動促進及終身健康習慣；(三) 心理健康之道，包括人格發展、情緒管理、人際關係，以及面對老化與死亡的健康調適；(四) 健康生活環境，包括物理、化學與生物環境、健康職場及健康休閒生活等議題。課程採講授、影片欣賞、分組討論及個別習作等多元教學方式，引導學生將健康知識應用於日常生活，培養自主健康管理與健康促進能力。
This course aims to equip students with fundamental health knowledge, positive health attitudes, and self-management skills to promote lifelong health and well-being. Through Health and Life, students will learn how to improve their health, reduce stress, and enjoy a healthier and more fulfilling life. They will explore lifestyle factors that influence health, develop a personal health improvement plan, and learn how to build a supportive and healthy environment with family and friends to achieve their health goals. The course is organized into four major components: (1) Health and Life, including the meaning of life, concepts of health, and understanding one's own body; (2) Physical Health, including healthy nutrition, weight management, physical activity, and lifelong healthy habits; (3) Mental Health, including personality development, emotional management, interpersonal relationships, and healthy adaptation to aging and death; and (4) Healthy Living Environments, including physical, chemical, and biological environments, healthy workplaces, and healthy leisure lifestyles. Through lectures, multimedia learning, group discussions, and individual assignments, students will apply health knowledge in daily life and develop lifelong self-care and health promotion competencies.
